proposed_title: Late-layer removal changes the two assignments in opposite directions
chart: opening effects plus free/forced habit decomposition
denominator: Opening-effect contrasts use 49 paired scenarios; endpoint cells can use 64, so do not subtract unmatched endpoints. Habit history battery retains 55 scenarios.
uncertainty: Stored scenario bootstrap intervals; retain authored half-counting for both habits.
caveats: Credit Tony for the band hypothesis. Middle-band free zero is onset suppression, not proof of a selector. Same-width later control also removes conduct shift. Prior blind checker used full both-counting and 64 opening scenarios, so some numbers differ without changing verdict.
